name: specnaut
description: Spec-driven workflow, slash commands, and sub-agents for AI coding harnesses — Specnaut's bundled skill library and agents.

interface.shortDescription: Spec-driven planning, TDD, review, and delivery workflows for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Specnaut turns vague ideas into shipped features through one disciplined pipeline: plan → tasks → implement → review → merge, with the plan audited for architecture and security before any code exists. The /specnaut router drives it, /board manages the backlog (GitHub/GitLab/local), /ship takes a release to production, and specialised sub-agents handle security, QA, DevOps and more — with constitutional governance and a Claude/Cursor/Codex/OpenCode/Copilot multi-harness distribution.
